abilities.description: After assigning your starting stats, add +1 to Wits. Always take +1 to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.a2d7793b23c17489]{Secure an Advantage}, and take +1 to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.9f538fabf8998c5b]{Compel} if you are leading others using preplanning. If your backstory has you raised on Csilla or amongst other Chiss, always @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.93d2d69b7e2b85e1]{Lose Momentum} (-1) when attempting to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.287bb4c2b53ea847]{Forge a Bond} with any non-Chiss, as you are not acclimated to other species and they find you off-putting.
Acute senses: Whenever making a move to see or maneuver in total darkness, add +2 due to your natural infrared vision.
